svg.text: Query result modes: Execute vs. StreamQuery vs. StreamRef
Materializes ALL matching rows in memory
early break stops scanning remaining pages
stack-only ref struct spans · no boxing
Choose Execute for small lookups, StreamQuery for large SQL exports or Take(n), and StreamRef for zero-GC table scans.
